missing_number_msg: If the number 1 is missing in your chart, you may struggle with self-expression and confidence. It becomes difficult for you to put your thoughts into words or take the lead in situations. Instead of focusing on yourself, you naturally shift your energy toward supporting and nurturing others. The good part is that you rarely face issues related to ego or self-pride, and people often find you humble, gentle, and easy to approach.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To strengthen the energy of the Sun, it is beneficial for you to donate items connected to its vibration. Offering gold, wheat, jaggery, saffron, brass utensils, or red clothes and red flowers in charity helps balance this missing number and enhances confidence, clarity, and self-identity.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 1 is missing, your stomach, back, chest, and eyes may become sensitive and require proper care.
remedies:
MISSING NUMBER 1:

  • Offer Water to sun on regular basis.
  • Have gratitude for your father/Respect you father.
  • Don’t not lie and always maintain intergrity.
  • Chant aditya hridya stotram.
  • Wear red color on Sunday.

missing_number_msg:
If number 2 is missing in your chart, you may experience a lack of sensitivity and intuition in your personality. You may become impatient, unpunctual, and often feel the need to explain or justify your action even when it isn't necessary. At times, you may leave tasks incomplete but still try to give explanations for them.

Because this number is missing, you tend to ignore your inner voice, even though it could guide you in the right direction. Learning to trust your intuition and creating emotional balance will help you move through life with more ease and clarity. Your key lesson is to understand how to live a balanced, calm, and harmonious life.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To strengthen the energy of the Moon, you can donate items associated with its vibration. Silver, white clothing, rice, milk, curd, sugar, white sandalwood, and other white items are especially beneficial. Offering these in charity helps improve emotional balance, intuition, and inner peace.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 2 is missing, you may face issues related to cold and cough, anxiety, liquid retention, blood-related problems, mood swings, and general mental restlessness.
remedies:
MISSING NUMBER 2:

  • Wear Clear Quartz Bracelet.
  • Offer water to shiv-ling on Monday.
  • Always respect your mother / Give Gratitude to your mother.
  • Chant Om Namah Shivay.

missing_number_msg: If number 3 is missing in your chart, it indicates a lack of self-confidence. You may find it difficult to express yourself clearly in many situations. When you face distractions or roadblocks, you might struggle to think logically or make clear decisions. This missing number can make it harder for you to organize your thoughts, plan ahead, or communicate your ideas confidently. Building inner confidence and improving communication skills will help you overcome these challenges.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To balance the energy of Jupiter, you should donate items that carry its vibration. Gold, brass, turmeric, honey, chana dal, saffron, yellow flowers, yellow clothes, and religious books are especially beneficial. Offering these items in charity helps strengthen wisdom, clarity, confidence, and overall growth.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 3 is missing, you may face issues related to the liver and skin.
remedies:

Wear Rudraksha, Tulsi Mala

missing_number_msg: If number 4 is missing in your chart, you may struggle with organizational skills. Following a fixed routine or working under strict rules can feel challenging for you. You may also experience moments of low self-esteem, especially when comparing yourself to others who appear more structured or disciplined. To overcome these challenges, you need to consciously build patience, tolerance, and consistency in your daily life. Developing a simple routine and sticking to it will help you become more stable and confident.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To strengthen the energy of Rahu, it is beneficial to donate items associated with it. Donating sesame seeds, sesame oil, and warm blankets helps reduce the negative effects of this missing number and brings clarity, discipline, and protection.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 4 is missing, you may face issues related to the stomach and digestion, including gastric discomfort or chronic conditions.
remedies:

missing_number_msg: If number 5 is missing in your chart, setting clear goals and staying focused on them becomes a major challenge for you. You may lack drive, versatility, and the ability to multitask. Instead of self-motivation, you often require external encouragement, reminders, and reinforcement to stay on the right track. To move forward effectively, you must learn how to set realistic goals and follow them consistently. Building discipline and structure will help you overcome the scattered energy caused by this missing number.
repetitiveNumberDonation:

Offering moong dal to the needy and giving green-colored sweets to ants is considered auspicious. Feeding green fodder (hara chara) to cows also helps balance this missing number and improves clarity, focus, and communication.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 5 is missing, you may experience issues related to the respiratory system, restlessness, skin problems, mental tension, and nervous system imbalance.

missing_number_msg: If number 6 is missing in your chart, you may find it difficult to express your innermost feelings openly. You often hold back emotionally, even in close relationships. This missing number can also make you less inclined toward selfless behavior, especially when it comes to giving love, care, or emotional support. At times, you may face challenges or misunderstandings with one of your parents. To bring balance into your life, you need to consciously cultivate the habit of giving from the heart sharing your emotions freely and openly with the people who matter to you.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To strengthen the energy of Venus, donating items associated with it is beneficial. Offering diamond, ghee, camphor, curd, silver items, rice, sugar, white clothes, or white flowers in charity helps balance this missing number and enhances love, harmony, charm, and emotional connection.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 6 is missing, you may experience issues related to sexual health (especially if there are too many 6s in the date of birth), frequent cold and cough, and problems affecting the lower part of the body.
remedies:

missing_number_msg:
If number 7 is missing in your chart, you may tend to live a self-absorbed or inward-focused life. This missing number can make you appear inconsiderate or insensitive at times, not because you lack kindness, but because you struggle to understand or respond to others’ emotional needs. You may also find it difficult to stay organized in your daily life, which affects your routine and productivity. Another challenge you face is a lack of independence you may depend on others more than you should for emotional or practical support.

To bring balance, you must learn open, honest, and free-flowing communication. When you start expressing your feelings clearly, you become more relaxed around people, and your relationships naturally improve.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To pacify the malefic effects of Ketu, donating items such as black pepper, seven types of grains, black cloth, and sesame seeds is considered highly beneficial. These donations help bring clarity, emotional balance, and inner stability.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 7 is missing, you may face health issues that are hidden or difficult to diagnose. Problems like frequent cold and cough, nasal congestion, lung-related issues, and various skin conditions may appear. Because the root cause is often not easy to identify, any persistent symptoms should be taken seriously.
remedies:

missing_number_msg: If number 8 is missing in your chart, you may struggle with handling your financial matters wisely. You tend to lack motivation and drive, which makes it difficult for you to complete tasks you may leave things unfinished midway. This missing number also makes you impulsive and somewhat careless, so you must think carefully before acting or making decisions. Your trusting nature can sometimes put your financial stability and security at risk. Learning discipline, caution, and patience will help you overcome these challenges.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To strengthen the energy of Saturn, it is beneficial to donate items such as iron, mustard oil, blankets, and leather goods. These donations help reduce the negative effects of this missing number and enhance stability, discipline, and long-term success.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 8 is missing, you may face issues related to sinus, respiratory troubles, and chronic diseases.

missing_number_msg: If number 9 is missing in your chart, you may sometimes appear insensitive or unaware of the needs and emotions of others. You may come across as detached or indifferent without realizing it. This missing number reduces the natural humanitarian quality that number 9 usually brings, so you must consciously develop compassion, empathy, and emotional understanding. You also need to become more open-hearted, candid, and giving in your interactions. By learning to connect with people on a deeper emotional level, you create healthier relationships and a more balanced personality.
repetitiveNumberDonation: To strengthen the energy of Mars, it is beneficial to donate items such as copper, ghee, wheat, jaggery, red clothes, masoor dal, red flowers, and red sandalwood. These donations help enhance courage, emotional warmth, compassion, and inner strength.
repetitiveNumberMedicalIssues: When number 9 is missing, you may experience issues related to the stomach and digestion. You are also more prone to small accidents or injuries because of Mars-related imbalances. People with this missing number often get hurt easily.
remedies:
